description: Renovate merges green minor/patch groups and lockfile maintenance itself.
platformAutomerge is off so that Renovate checks all checks itself before merging, even without required checks in branch protection.
Major updates and the Python runtime need a decision and are never merged automatically.

packageRules.description: Python packages (uv workspace): minor and patch in one PR
Container images (Dockerfiles, Compose): minor and patch in one PR
GitHub Actions: minor and patch in one PR

description: Python runtime (base image, .python-version) on its own, because a jump from 3.14 to 3.15 counts as minor for Docker.
NOTE: held at 3.14.x because eccodeslib/eckitlib do not ship wheels for 3.15 yet (https://github.com/ecmwf/eccodes/issues/629).
Remove allowedVersions once all dependencies support 3.15 (issue #84).

packageRules.description: Major updates stay separate PRs and get a label
